mapper.select: select og.sys_id , og.order_num , og.order_status , og.cancel_reason , og.cancel_description , json_agg( json_build_object( 'menuName', smd.menu_name , 'qty', od.qty , 'price', COALESCE(od.order_unit_price, smd.menu_price) , 'totalPrice', case when od.payment_yn = 'Y' then COALESCE(od.order_unit_price, smd.menu_price) * od.qty else 0 end , 'paymentYn', od.payment_yn , 'options', ( select json_agg(json_build_object( 'optionName', smod.menu_option_name , 'qty', odo.qty , 'price', COALESCE(odo.order_unit_price, smod.menu_option_price) , 'totalPrice', case when od.payment_yn = 'Y' then COALESCE(odo.order_unit_price, smod.menu_option_price) * odo.qty else 0 end )) from order_detail_option odo left join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 where odo.link_sys_id = od.sys_id ) ) ) as items from order_group og inner join order_master om on om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id inner join order_detail od on od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id left join store_menu_detail smd on smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 where og.link_sys_id = #{masterSysId} and om.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and not exists ( select 1 from client_order_revision_removed_detail removed where removed.order_detail_sys_id = od.sys_id ) group by og.sys_id, og.order_num, og.order_status, og.cancel_reason, og.cancel_description
